title: Lesson 26: Enterprise REST API Design: Versioning, Pagination, Bulk, and Best Practices
description: The design layer under every REST integration: how Salesforce versions its API, how to page through large result sets without breaking, when bulk writes beat synchronous calls, and the habits that keep an integration alive for years.
